answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 183895 Country: India Title: Do Madhi and Wadi Have Smell? And Can You Pray Salah in Same Cloth? Question: Sometimes my pants are wet and I don't even know when it becomes. I think it is mazi or wadi. But I've read they have no smell. But little smell comes. And can I pray in it? If I can't pray in the same cloth then can I pray it in it if it's absolutely necessary? Answer ID: 183895 Posted on: Dec 23, 2021 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 614/492/B=5/1443) There is no odour in Madhi or Wadi, but both are unclean. It is not lawful to offer salah without washing it if it is more than a dirham. Therefore, when your pants get wet with madhi, you should change it or wash it and offer salah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
